_comment: Failure Intelligence Agent (Phase 4) config. Tunable without code changes — edit and restart. Fault thresholds themselves live in data/fault_taxonomy.json; this file holds agent-level policy: severity, broadband detection, recommended checks, confidence blend, logging.

severity._comment: Base severity from ISO stage, then escalate one level if the asset is high-criticality and/or a production bottleneck.

broadband._comment: Broadband pattern = vib_rms elevated vs baseline AND no single defect band dominates (neither BPFO nor BPFI crosses its own stage-1 multiple). Used to route to FT_003 lubrication_issue.

FT_001: Inspect bearing outer race for spalling/brinelling via envelope analysis
Confirm BPFO frequency tracks shaft speed (rule out electrical/structural source)
Re-measure vibration within the stage RUL window and trend BPFO energy
FT_002: Inspect bearing inner race and rolling elements
Check for overload or coupling misalignment driving inner-race loading
Verify BPFI sidebands at 1X shaft-speed spacing in the spectrum
FT_003: Verify lubricant level, grade, and condition
Check last lubrication date against the maintenance schedule
Sample oil/grease for contamination, water ingress, and viscosity
FT_006: Inspect cage integrity and rolling-element spacing
Check FTF frequency and look for irregular BSF modulation
Review lubrication history — cage faults are frequently lubrication-driven
fault_checks._comment_FT_007: Added by Prateek Mittal on 20th July 2026. The roadmap defines BSF as a ball/rolling-element signature; gearbox is asset context, not the diagnosed bearing component.
FT_007: Inspect balls or rollers for pitting, spalling, scoring, or skidding
Confirm BSF and BSF sidebands track shaft speed and bearing geometry
Review lubricant condition and check for contamination or overload
undetermined: Schedule manual vibration spectrum review by a reliability engineer
Capture a high-resolution envelope spectrum for offline analysis
Compare against historical baselines for this bearing

confidence._comment: Final confidence = anomaly_confidence-weighted blend with match_strength (how decisively the fault signature was crossed). Weights must sum to 1.0.
